metadata.description: Fully capable tools for supported data and release workflows, proven with repeatable public demos.

plugins.name: contentsweep-supplier-feeds
plugins.description: Proven recurring supplier imports: approve and reuse profiles, preserve SKUs and decimals, and stop drift. Repeatable demo with verified receipts.

plugins.name: contentsweep-quality
plugins.description: Proven whole-file preflight for CRM imports, with continue, block and warning decisions. Repeatable demo catches a duplicate at row 12,002.

plugins.name: contentsweep-inspector
plugins.description: Proven local Python/FastAPI release inspection and before/after handoffs. Repeatable demo resolves ten findings without source upload or execution.

plugins.name: contentsweep-schema-mapper
plugins.description: Proven reviewed vendor mapping with exact identifiers and decimals, reusable transforms and drift stops. Includes a repeatable local MCP demo.

plugins.name: contentsweep-dag-doctor
plugins.description: Proven exported Airflow incident diagnosis with evidence-linked findings. Repeatable hosted and free local demos show executor mismatch and context stops.

plugins.name: contentsweep-deployment-fixer
plugins.description: Proven static FastAPI deployment assessments with file-linked blockers and support checks. Repeatable hosted and free local demos; no builds or AWS actions.
